app_id.description: The App the Space belongs to (SW13); absent for a Space of K2's own.

hidden.description:
Meet MC1 (CC4): a hidden Space, left out of `GET /spaces`, browse, the directory and
(without the `hidden_spaces` capability) READY. Set at create only. Default `false`.

managers.description:
0–10 distinct members who join and hold the manager role (persons or coworker agents,
not the owner).

items.description: An external identity: k2:principal:<uuid>, k2:workspace:<uuid>, k2:connect:<uuid>, k2:owner, local:<handle> or link:<channel_id>:<base32> (a meeting link guest).

owner.description: The owner: `k2:owner` or a person (never an agent).

slug.description: The slug; `dm` is reserved. The idempotency key of the create.
